recipes.steps: Sear the beef, add garlic, season with soy sauce.

recipes.title: Home-style beef stir-fry
recipes.steps: Fry the ginger, cook the beef through, add soy sauce, then cooking wine.
recipes.page_text: Home-style beef stir-fry. 1. Fry the ginger in oil. 2. Add the beef and cook until no pink remains. 3. Add a spoonful of soy sauce. 4. Add the cooking wine and stir for 30 seconds.
